profile.name: 扫描器通信接口
profile.description: 用于实验系统中的非物理扫描器通信组件，提供向扫描器发送命令以及暴露文件描述符的能力，便于将设备通信接入事件循环、轮询或底层 I/O 监控流程。
profile.description_en: A non-physical scanner communication component used in laboratory systems. It provides methods to send commands to a scanner and expose a file descriptor, enabling integration with event loops, polling, or low-level I/O monitoring.
